newsitem.title: UK: Egypt hopes for 8-pct growth by 2000-minister.
newsitem.headline: Egypt hopes for 8-pct growth by 2000-minister.

text.p: Egypt hopes to achieve annualized growth rate of 8.0 percent by the end of the century but increased investment is necessary in order to reach those goals, Youssef Boutros-Ghali, Egyptian Minister of State for Economic Affairs said on Thursday.
"Investment stands at the heart of growth rates. We achieved 5.0 percent but that is not enough. We need 8.0 percent," Boutros-Ghali told an investment conference in London.
Boutros-Ghali said domestic savings rate of around 25 to 28 percent and export growth of 20 percent is also required to meet the country's economic aims of 8.0 percent growth.
Egypt has implemented six years of an orthodox reform program but Boutros-Ghali said more needs to be done to create sustainable economic growth.
He said "predictable macro policies" and a "predictable regulatory system" needs to be the basis for the country's economic policies.
Boutros-Ghali noted that economic growth also must benefit all of Eguptian society. "It is important that everyone benefits from new growth," he said.
